key: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
en: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
ja: アンナ: あ、\PN!

key: And hello, train!
en: And hello, train!
ja: それと、列車さんこんにちは!

key: I bet this'll do! I'll go get the others, okay?
en: I bet this'll do! I'll go get the others, okay?
ja: これでいけると思う! みんなを呼んでくるね!

key: ANNA: Well? What do you think? Can we use it?
en: ANNA: Well? What do you think? Can we use it?
ja: アンナ: どう? これ、使えそう?

key: CHARLOTTE: What, you think I know anything about this stuff?
en: CHARLOTTE: What, you think I know anything about this stuff?
ja: シャルロット: は? あたしがこういうのに詳しいとでも思ってんの?

key: Good one.
en: Good one.
ja: 冗談キツいって。

key: But we sure can try.
en: But we sure can try.
ja: でも、やってみる価値はあるか。

key: How hard can it be?
en: How hard can it be?
ja: どうせ大したことないでしょ。

key: NOEL: This isn't close to the exit.
en: NOEL: This isn't close to the exit.
ja: ノエル: 出口には近くないですね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Nope, but as long as the track is intact, all I really need to do is find the thing that makes it go forward and hope on all our lives it works.
en: CHARLOTTE: Nope, but as long as the track is intact, all I really need to do is find the thing that makes it go forward and hope on all our lives it works.
ja: シャルロット: そうね、でもレールさえ無事なら、前に進ませるものを見つけて、命がけで動くように祈るだけよ。

key: CAIN: And how about them brakes?
en: CAIN: And how about them brakes?
ja: カイン: で、ブレーキのほうはどうすんの?

key: CHARLOTTE: Who needs those?
en: CHARLOTTE: Who needs those?
ja: シャルロット: そんなもの誰が要るのよ?

key: ANNA: So our first job has to be making sure the tracks connect, right?
en: ANNA: So our first job has to be making sure the tracks connect, right?
ja: アンナ: じゃあ最初にやることは、レールがちゃんとつながってるか確認することだね?

key: SHELLY: I did see a lot of switches out there...
en: SHELLY: I did see a lot of switches out there...
ja: シェリー: 外にたくさん分岐器があったのを見ました……

key: NOEL: Only twelve.
en: NOEL: Only twelve.
ja: ノエル: 十二個だけです。

key: CAIN: Plus some of the rails are all broken up, right?
en: CAIN: Plus some of the rails are all broken up, right?
ja: カイン: それに、レールの一部は壊れてるんだろ?

key: NOEL: That's advantageous.
en: NOEL: That's advantageous.
ja: ノエル: それは好都合ですね。

key: SHELLY: Um... H-how so?
en: SHELLY: Um... H-how so?
ja: シェリー: あの……ど、どうしてですか?

key: NOEL: If we ignore positions that lead to an immediate dead-end, the number of possible combinations is reduced from 46,656 to 8.
en: NOEL: If we ignore positions that lead to an immediate dead-end, the number of possible combinations is reduced from 46,656 to 8.
ja: ノエル: 即座に行き止まりになる位置を除外すれば、組み合わせの数は46,656通りから8通りまで減ります。

key: CAIN: How do you know that?
en: CAIN: How do you know that?
ja: カイン: なんでそんなこと分かんの?

key: NOEL: Isn't it obvious?
en: NOEL: Isn't it obvious?
ja: ノエル: 当然のことでは?

key: CAIN: Yeah... No.
en: CAIN: Yeah... No.
ja: カイン: いや……全然。

key: ANNA: So all we really need to do to find out if we can get the train to the rubble is check those eight combinations?
en: ANNA: So all we really need to do to find out if we can get the train to the rubble is check those eight combinations?
ja: アンナ: じゃあ、列車をがれきまで進められるか確かめるには、その8通りを試せばいいってこと?

key: CHARLOTTE: All right, \PN, you're up.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right, \PN, you're up.
ja: シャルロット: よし、\PN、あんたの出番よ。

key: If more than one person does this, we're likely to mix stuff up.
en: If more than one person does this, we're likely to mix stuff up.
ja: 複数人でやると、ごちゃごちゃになりそうだから。

key: Look for a route for this train to get to the exit and have Noel check it over.
en: Look for a route for this train to get to the exit and have Noel check it over.
ja: この列車が出口まで行けるルートを探して、ノエルに確認してもらって。

key: Then we can get this show on the road.
en: Then we can get this show on the road.
ja: それができたら、いよいよ出発ね。

key: ANNA: We'll wait outside for you. C'mon, Noel~
en: ANNA: We'll wait outside for you. C'mon, Noel~
ja: アンナ: 外で待ってるね。ほら、ノエルも行くよ~

key: CHARLOTTE: Look for a route for this train to get to the exit and have Noel check it over.
en: CHARLOTTE: Look for a route for this train to get to the exit and have Noel check it over.
ja: シャルロット: この列車が出口まで行けるルートを探して、ノエルに確認してもらって。

key: HEATHER: ...
en: HEATHER: ...
ja: ヘザー: ……

key: CAIN: I dunno about all this combination stuff; the only thing I can count is beats.
en: CAIN: I dunno about all this combination stuff; the only thing I can count is beats.
ja: カイン: 組み合わせとかよく分かんねーけど、オレが数えられるのはビートだけだな。

key: So, your heart still qualifies~
en: So, your heart still qualifies~
ja: だから、お前のハートならまだ数えられるぜ~

key: CAIN: Now we just have to hope Charlotte knows what she's doing, huh?
en: CAIN: Now we just have to hope Charlotte knows what she's doing, huh?
ja: カイン: あとはシャルロットが分かってることを祈るだけだな?

key: Well, if these are my last moments, it's not so bad with you around!
en: Well, if these are my last moments, it's not so bad with you around!
ja: ま、これが最後の瞬間だとしても、お前がいてくれるなら悪くないぜ!

key: CAIN: I'm not sure which I'm more concerned about:
en: CAIN: I'm not sure which I'm more concerned about:
ja: カイン: どっちが心配か分かんねーな。

key: What happened to the train, or the fact that Heather hasn't reacted even to that.
en: What happened to the train, or the fact that Heather hasn't reacted even to that.
ja: 列車がどうなるかってことか、それともヘザーがそれにすら反応しないことか。

key: SHELLY: Do you think there really is a way out?
en: SHELLY: Do you think there really is a way out?
ja: シェリー: 本当に、出られる道なんてあるんでしょうか?

key: SHELLY: So... So we can get out after all?
en: SHELLY: So... So we can get out after all?
ja: シェリー: じゃあ……じゃあ、やっぱり出られるんですか?

key: U-um, does that mean--
en: U-um, does that mean--
ja: あ、あの、それって――

key: Was I useful at all?
en: Was I useful at all?
ja: わたし、少しは役に立てましたか?

key: SHELLY: I-I'm really happy!
en: SHELLY: I-I'm really happy!
ja: シェリー: う、うれしいです!

key: Okay, let's get out of here and get Heather to safety!
en: Okay, let's get out of here and get Heather to safety!
ja: さあ、ここを出て、ヘザーを安全な場所へ!

key: SHELLY: Oh...
en: SHELLY: Oh...
ja: シェリー: あ……

key: Okay...
en: Okay...
ja: はい……

key: I'll-- I'll try harder next time, okay?
en: I'll-- I'll try harder next time, okay?
ja: つ、次はもっと頑張りますから……

key: I'm sorry...
en: I'm sorry...
ja: ごめんなさい……

key: SHELLY: Let's get out of here and get Heather to safety!
en: SHELLY: Let's get out of here and get Heather to safety!
ja: シェリー: ここを出て、ヘザーを安全な場所へ!

key: SHELLY: I'm sorry...
en: SHELLY: I'm sorry...
ja: シェリー: ごめんなさい……

key: SHELLY: W-we didn't mess up, did we...?
en: SHELLY: W-we didn't mess up, did we...?
ja: シェリー: わ、わたしたち、失敗してませんよね……?

key: CHARLOTTE: I hear the path's been blazed for us.
en: CHARLOTTE: I hear the path's been blazed for us.
ja: シャルロット: 道はもう切り開かれてるみたいね。

key: You all set to do this?
en: You all set to do this?
ja: 準備はいい?

key: CHARLOTTE: Sweet.
en: CHARLOTTE: Sweet.
ja: シャルロット: よし。

key: CHARLOTTE: All right, let's do this.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right, let's do this.
ja: シャルロット: よし、やるわよ。

key: *Tschk* This is your captain speaking.
en: *Tschk* This is your captain speaking.
ja: ザザッ……こちら機長です。

key: We will be departing from the station shortly.
en: We will be departing from the station shortly.
ja: まもなく駅を出発いたします。

key: Please keep all arms and legs securely inside the vehicle at all times,
en: Please keep all arms and legs securely inside the vehicle at all times,
ja: 手足は常に車内にしっかりとお納めのうえ、

key: And hang the fuck on because we're in for a hell of a ride.
en: And hang the fuck on because we're in for a hell of a ride.
ja: しっかりつかまってなさい、地獄みたいな乗り心地になるからね。

key: SHELLY: U-um...
en: SHELLY: U-um...
ja: シェリー: あ　あの……

key: CAIN: Did you change your mind about the brakes?
en: CAIN: Did you change your mind about the brakes?
ja: カイン: ブレーキのこと、気が変わったのか?

key: CHARLOTTE: As if...
en: CHARLOTTE: As if...
ja: シャルロット: まさか……

key: SHELLY: So... So what just happened?
en: SHELLY: So... So what just happened?
ja: シェリー: あの……今、何が起きたんですか?

key: CHARLOTTE: Only one way to find out.
en: CHARLOTTE: Only one way to find out.
ja: シャルロット: それを知る方法は一つしかないわね。

key: We got through the debris, but it doesn't seem like we can go further, so let's step out and take a look.
en: We got through the debris, but it doesn't seem like we can go further, so let's step out and take a look.
ja: がれきは抜けたけど、これ以上は進めなさそうだから、降りて見てみましょう。

key: CHARLOTTE: No sweat. I'll be here when they drop.
en: CHARLOTTE: No sweat. I'll be here when they drop.
ja: シャルロット: 平気平気。落ちてきてもここで待ってるから。

key: CHARLOTTE: Tch, brakes.
en: CHARLOTTE: Tch, brakes.
ja: シャルロット: チッ、ブレーキね。

key: Just who does he think I am...
en: Just who does he think I am...
ja: あいつ、あたしを何だと思ってんのよ……

key: NOEL: Good job arranging the path.
en: NOEL: Good job arranging the path.
ja: ノエル: 経路の設定、お疲れさまでした。

key: NOEL: Anna, are you really okay?
en: NOEL: Anna, are you really okay?
ja: ノエル: アンナ、本当に大丈夫ですか?

key: ANNA: All ready to set sail!?
en: ANNA: All ready to set sail!?
ja: アンナ: 出航準備、万端だよ!?

key: Oh, and don't worry about me, I just slipped on a rock! I think.
en: Oh, and don't worry about me, I just slipped on a rock! I think.
ja: あ、あたしのことは心配しないで、石で滑っただけだから! たぶん。

key: It shouldn't happen again!
en: It shouldn't happen again!
ja: もう二度と起きないはず!

key: ANNA: Hey, does Nostra feel cold to you?
en: ANNA: Hey, does Nostra feel cold to you?
ja: アンナ: ねえ、ノストラって寒く感じない?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
